decisions.rationale: Lead Incineroar+Weavile for Intimidate/Fake Out control and priority Ice Shard to revenge Gale Wings Talonflame plus Icicle Crash pressure on Garchomp. Back Venusaur-Mega to absorb Rotom-Wash and Gardevoir-Mega for Pixilate Hyper Voice coverage on Garchomp/Overqwil. This four answers the opponent's core threats while benching Sneasler/Skarmory.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster confirmed: Aegislash(Occa), Overqwil(Intimidate), Rotom-Wash(WideLens), Garchomp(Lum, RoughSkin), Talonflame(GaleWings, SharpBeak), Floette-Eternal(Floettite, FlowerVeil). No Serperior/Absol/Spiritomb/Manectric. Plan: Weavile Ice Shard revenges Talonflame; Icicle Crash hits Garchomp; Venusaur-Mega Giga Drain beats Rotom-Wash; Gardevoir-Mega Hyper Voice threatens Garchomp/Overqwil; Incineroar answers Aegislash. Watch RoughSkin recoil on contact moves vs Garchomp.

decisions.rationale: Lead Aegislash+Overqwil: Wide Guard erases Pixilate Hyper Voice, Intimidate softens Incineroar/Weavile/Sneasler, and Poison Jab heavily pressures Gardevoir. Aegislash can King's Shield scout or let Overqwil pivot to Talonflame against Venusaur/Weavile leads. Back Talonflame then Rotom: Talonflame gives Tailwind, outspeeds max Weavile, and hits Venusaur/Sneasler hard; Rotom answers Incineroar and Skarmory. This four covers both megas and the physical speedsters.
decisions.notebook: Format fact: Rotom-Wash is Electric/Water here, not Ghost; do not rely on Fake Out or Close Combat immunities, only Levitate Ground immunity. Preferred core: Aegislash, Overqwil, Talonflame, Rotom-Wash; leave Garchomp/Floette unless opponent composition changes. Aegislash walls Mega Gardevoir and Sneasler, Wide Guard blocks Pixilate Hyper Voice, King's Shield scouts; Flash Cannon is only 45-79% on Mega Gardevoir, so pair with Overqwil. Overqwil Intimidate is key; Poison Jab is 97-193% on Gardevoir, so not guaranteed vs bulkiest spreads; Taunt stops Skarmory Roost/Tailwind and Venusaur support. Talonflame at 195 Speed outruns max Weavile 194; Flare Blitz is 88-174% on Weavile, Brave Bird OHKOs Sneasler but Focus Sash leaves 1 HP and Unburden activates, so keep Aegislash or a follow-up ready. Talonflame survives Life Orb Icicle Crash 62-90%. Rotom Hydro Pump is 75-135% on Incineroar with Wide Lens accuracy 88%; Thunderbolt is 84-164% on Skarmory but Sturdy/chip can prevent immediate KO. Venusaur Earth Power is 41-63% on Aegislash; pivot to Talonflame vs Venusaur leads. Game 2: if they lean Sneasler/Fighting, consider Floette; if they drop Skarmory/Venusaur and need spread Ground, consider Garchomp; keep Aegislash answer for Gardevoir.

decisions.rationale: Weavile is my Talonflame revenge killer and is OHKO'd by Aegislash Sacred Sword (4x, 117-138%) and possibly Flash Cannon; Protect to scout and preserve it. Incineroar Fake Out flinches Overqwil to stop Taunt/attack. Avoid contact moves vs possible King's Shield (blocks and drops Attack).
decisions.notebook: Roster confirmed: Aegislash(Occa,StanceChange,Quiet), Overqwil(Intimidate,PoisonBarb,Adamant), Rotom-Wash(WideLens), Garchomp(Lum,RoughSkin), Talonflame(GaleWings,SharpBeak), Floette-Eternal(Floettite,FlowerVeil). No Serperior/Absol/Spiritomb/Manectric. Plan: Weavile Ice Shard revenges Talonflame; Icicle Crash hits Garchomp; Venusaur-Mega Giga Drain beats Rotom-Wash; Gardevoir-Mega Hyper Voice threatens Garchomp/Overqwil; Incineroar answers Aegislash. Key calcs: Aegislash Sacred Sword OHKOs Weavile (4x); Flash Cannon can OHKO Weavile; Weavile Knock Off vs Aegislash 37-77% (removes Occa); Incineroar Darkest Lariat 33-72%, Flare Blitz w/Occa 24-51%; Overqwil Poison Jab vs Weavile 45-78%. Aegislash Shield Forme bulky; all my physical contact moves blocked by King's Shield (+4, drops Attack). Preserve Weavile as Talonflame answer; avoid contact vs Aegislash. Watch RoughSkin recoil on contact vs Garchomp.

decisions.rationale: Aegislash must King's Shield: Weavile Knock Off at -1 still does 63-91% and removes Occa Berry, while Aegislash is too slow to attack safely. Overqwil Protect blocks Fake Out flinch and Parting Shot/attacks; its -1 Poison Jab is only 33-64% on Weavile. Double protect scouts turn 1, preserves items/HP, then pivot/reset Overqwil.
decisions.notebook: Format fact: Rotom-Wash is Electric/Water; only Levitate Ground immunity. Preferred core Aegislash, Overqwil, Talonflame, Rotom-Wash. Aegislash walls Mega Gardevoir and Sneasler; Wide Guard blocks Pixilate Hyper Voice; King's Shield scouts and preserves Occa Berry against Knock Off. Weavile Knock Off can heavily damage Aegislash and remove Occa, so shield before taking it. Overqwil Poison Jab is weak after Intimidate; switch it out to reset before offensive use, but keep it for Taunt and Gardevoir pressure. Talonflame 195 Speed outruns max Weavile; Flare Blitz 88-174% Weavile, Brave Bird OHKOes Sneasler to Focus Sash 1 HP; Talonflame survives Life Orb Icicle Crash 62-90%. Rotom Hydro Pump 75-135% Incineroar with Wide Lens 88%; Thunderbolt 84-164% Skarmory but Sturdy/chip. Venusaur Earth Power 41-63% Aegislash; pivot Talonflame vs Venusaur. Vs Incineroar/Weavile leads, double Protect is a safe opening; expect Fake Out, Parting Shot, or pivot. Game 2: if they lean Sneasler/Fighting consider Floette; if they drop Skarmory/Venusaur and need spread Ground consider Garchomp; keep Aegislash answer for Gardevoir.

decisions.rationale: Aegislash threatens to OHKO Weavile (Sacred Sword 4x, Flash Cannon 2x), so I switch Weavile out to preserve my Talonflame answer. Incineroar stays as my Aegislash answer with Darkest Lariat (super-effective, ignores Occa since it's Dark). If Aegislash attacks it becomes frail Blade Forme and gets punished; if it King's Shields it's passive and Incineroar can pivot later. Venusaur comes in to threaten Overqwil with super-effective Earth Power.
decisions.notebook: Roster confirmed: Aegislash(Occa,StanceChange,Quiet), Overqwil(Intimidate,PoisonBarb,Adamant), Rotom-Wash(WideLens), Garchomp(Lum,RoughSkin), Talonflame(GaleWings,SharpBeak), Floette-Eternal(Floettite,FlowerVeil). No Serperior/Absol/Spiritomb/Manectric. Roles: Weavile revenges Talonflame (Ice Shard) and outspeeds it; Venusaur-Mega Giga Drain beats Rotom-Wash, Earth Power super-effective vs Overqwil; Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice threatens Garchomp/Overqwil; Incineroar answers Aegislash (Darkest Lariat super-effective, ignores Occa; Flare Blitz reduced by Occa). Key calcs: Aegislash Sacred Sword OHKOs Weavile (4x), Flash Cannon can OHKO Weavile; Weavile Knock Off vs Aegislash 37-77% (removes Occa); Incineroar Darkest Lariat 33-72%, Flare Blitz w/Occa 24-51%; Overqwil Poison Jab vs Weavile 45-78%. Aegislash Shield Forme bulky; King's Shield blocks contact and drops attacker Atk 2. Avoid contact vs Aegislash when it may King's Shield; RoughSkin recoil on contact vs Garchomp. Preserve Weavile as Talonflane answer. Neither Venusaur nor Gardevoir can hit Aegislash well (Earth Power 0x Ghost, Hyper Voice 0x Ghost, Moonblast/Psyshock 0.5x Steel).

decisions.rationale: Switch Aegislash out to preserve it from Weavile Knock Off and possible Incineroar fire focus. Talonflame safely enters, outspeeds Weavile, and can pressure it next turn. Overqwil stays to Taunt Incineroar: either denying Parting Shot or Taunting the switch-in. This avoids risky consecutive King's Shield/Protect.
decisions.notebook: Format: Rotom-Wash is Electric/Water; only Levitate gives Ground immunity. Core: Aegislash, Overqwil, Talonflame, Rotom-Wash. Opponent likely leads Incineroar/Weavile and pivots with Parting Shot after Fake Out; Overqwil Taunt on Incineroar's slot can deny the pivot or Taunt the replacement. Preserve Aegislash's Occa Berry from Weavile Knock Off; avoid leaving it in for Knock Off plus Fire attack. Aegislash walls Mega Gardevoir and Sneasler; Wide Guard blocks Pixilate Hyper Voice; King's Shield scouts, but avoid chaining due reduced success. Talonflame 195 Speed outruns max Weavile; Flare Blitz is primary Weavile removal and pivots vs Venusaur/Skarmory/Sneasler, though Sharp Beak only boosts Brave Bird. Rotom-Wash Hydro Pump threatens Incineroar with Wide Lens accuracy; Thunderbolt chips Skarmory through Sturdy; Will-O-Wisp neuters physical attackers. Overqwil at -1 Attack is weak; use Taunt/utility, then switch to reset before Poison Jab; Poison Jab pressures Gardevoir. Game 2: if they lean Sneasler/Fighting consider Floette; if they drop Skarmory/Venusaur and need spread Ground consider Garchomp; keep an Aegislash answer for Gardevoir.

decisions.rationale: Talonflame (51%) is the fastest and the Tailwind speed-control threat; it acts first but Venusaur-Mega survives its Brave Bird (46-88%) and Thick Fat-reduced Flare Blitz. Both Incineroar Darkest Lariat (23-57%) and Venusaur-Mega Sludge Bomb (39-94%) target it, guaranteeing the KO (min combined ~63%>51%) and removing speed control. Venusaur Mega Evolves for Thick Fat bulk and higher SpA. Overqwil's attacks are only 0.5x vs our actives, so it's not urgent.
decisions.notebook: Calcs: Incineroar Darkest Lariat vs Talonflame 23-57% (Atk -1); Venusaur-Mega Sludge Bomb vs Talonflame 39-94%; Venusaur-Mega Earth Power vs Overqwil 53-126% (possible OHKO, 2x); Venusaur-Mega survives Talonflame Brave Bird 46-88% and Flare Blitz (Thick Fat) 23-45%. Incineroar Flare Blitz vs Overqwil 27-60% (neutral). Talonflame acts before Venusaur (160-195 vs 100). Overqwil's Throat Chop/Poison Jab only 0.5x vs Incineroar/Venusaur-Mega. Plan: Weavile (Ice Shard, priority) is the Talonflame finisher; Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice threatens Garchomp/Overqwil; Venusaur-Mega Giga Drain beats Rotom-Wash; Incineroar Darkest Lariat answers Aegislash (ignores Occa). Avoid contact vs Aegislash King's Shield and Garchomp RoughSkin.

decisions.rationale: Protect Talonflame and pivot Overqwil into Rotom-Wash. This preserves Talonflame from Sludge Bomb/Ice attacks, lets Rotom absorb likely Earth Power and check Incineroar/Weavile, and resets Overqwil's lowered Attack. Attacking Venusaur now risks Talonflame if Brave Bird fails or if they switch Weavile/Skarmory; the pivot keeps Brave Bird/Flare Blitz options for next turn.
decisions.notebook: Core: Aegislash, Overqwil, Talonflame, Rotom-Wash. Opponent likely leads Incineroar/Weavile and pivots with Parting Shot; Taunt denies pivots. Preserve Aegislash's Occa Berry from Knock Off + Fire; Aegislash walls Mega Gardevoir and Sneasler, Wide Guard blocks Pixilate Hyper Voice, avoid chaining King's Shield. Talonflame outspeeds max Weavile; Brave Bird is preferred vs Venusaur/Mega Venusaur because Thick Fat halves Flare Blitz; Flare Blitz hits Weavile/Skarmory hard. Rotom-Wash is a safe Ground-immune pivot vs Venusaur Earth Power, checks Incineroar/Weavile; Hydro Pump threatens Incineroar, Thunderbolt chips Skarmory through Sturdy, Will-O-Wisp neuters physical attackers. Beware predicted Giga Drain on Rotom. If Overqwil is Intimidated, switch it out to reset before attacking; Taunt and Poison Jab are its main utility. Game 2: if they lean Fighting/Sneasler consider Floette; if they drop Skarmory/Venusaur and need spread Ground consider Garchomp; keep Aegislash as Gardevoir answer.

decisions.rationale: Talonflame is the fast threat; double into it to guarantee the KO (Sludge Bomb 39-94% + Darkest Lariat 23-57% combined exceeds its 51%). Incineroar is Taunted so must attack; Darkest Lariat is neutral vs Talonflame (Flare Blitz is 0.5x). Venusaur is safe from Rotom (both moves 0.5x) and survives Talonflame's Brave Bird/Flare Blitz. Talonflame's Protect success is reduced after last turn, so doubling is low-risk.
decisions.notebook: Calcs: Venusaur-Mega Sludge Bomb vs Talonflame 39-94%; Incineroar Darkest Lariat (Atk-1) vs Talonflame 23-57%; combined guarantees KO on 51%. Weavile Ice Shard (Life Orb) vs Talonflame only 15-54% — NOT a reliable finisher, don't rely on it. Rotom-Wash Hydro Pump vs Incineroar 63-114% (possible OHKO; Sitrus Berry helps if it survives). Venusaur-Mega Giga Drain vs Rotom-Wash 61-136% (possible OHKO). Venusaur-Mega is safe vs Rotom (Hydro Pump & Thunderbolt both 0.5x) and survives Talonflame Brave Bird (46-88%) / Flare Blitz w/ Thick Fat (23-45%). Plan: remove Talonflame speed threat first; Venusaur Giga Drain beats Rotom-Wash; Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice threatens Garchomp/Overqwil; Incineroar Darkest Lariat answers Aegislash (ignores Occa). Avoid contact vs Aegislash King's Shield and Garchomp RoughSkin. Overqwil's Throat Chop/Poison Jab only 0.5x vs Incineroar/Venusaur-Mega.

decisions.rationale: Bring Gardevoir: Intimidate-proof special attacker that counters Overqwil (likely switch-in) with 2x Moonblast; if Aegislash comes instead, Gardevoir is mediocre but Aegislash is defensive (King's Shield), a less punishing miss. Venusaur Giga Drains Rotom (possible OHKO + heal). Keep fast Weavile on bench for later speed control.
decisions.notebook: Venusaur already Mega'd, so Gardevoir cannot Mega this game (stays regular, Trace, no Pixilate). Overqwil's Intimidate re-triggers on each switch-in. Weavile speed 194 outspeeds all foes (Rotom 106-138, Aegislash 72-100, Overqwil 105-137). Venusaur Giga Drain vs Rotom 61-136% possible OHKO; Venusaur safe vs Rotom (Hydro Pump/Thunderbolt both 0.5x). Gardevoir Moonblast 2x vs Overqwil, 0.5x vs Aegislash. Weavile Knock Off 2x vs Aegislash but contact (King's Shield risk); Icicle Crash 0.5x vs Aegislash, 1x vs Overqwil. Avoid contact vs Aegislash King's Shield and Garchomp RoughSkin. Incineroar gone; Taunt on it irrelevant now. Future: keep Weavile for speed/priority Ice Shard; Gardevoir handles Overqwil, Weavile handles Aegislash.

decisions.rationale: Talonflame outspeeds all; Brave Bird (2x SE, Sharp Beak) deals 67-116% to Venusaur-Mega with OHKO potential. Rotom's Hydro Pump (2x SE, Wide Lens) deals 75-135% to Incineroar, also potential OHKO. Aggressive double-attack maximizes KO probability before Venusaur can Giga Drain Rotom (73-107%). Incineroar at -1 Atk is neutered; Taunt blocks its Parting Shot escape.
decisions.notebook: Core: Aegislash, Overqwil, Talonflame, Rotom-Wash. Opponent leads Incineroar/Weavile, pivots with Parting Shot; Taunt denies pivots. Preserve Aegislash's Occa Berry from Knock Off + Fire; Aegislash walls Mega Gardevoir and Sneasler, Wide Guard blocks Pixilate Hyper Voice, avoid chaining King's Shield. Talonflame outspeeds max Weavile; Brave Bird preferred vs Venusaur (Thick Fat halves Flare Blitz); Flare Blitz hits Weavile/Skarmory. Rotom-Wash is Ground-immune pivot vs Venusaur Earth Power, checks Incineroar/Weavile; Hydro Pump threatens Incineroar, Thunderbolt chips Skarmory through Sturdy, Will-O-Wisp neuters physical attackers. Beware predicted Giga Drain on Rotom. If Overqwil is Intimidated, switch to reset before attacking. Game 2: if they lean Fighting/Sneasler consider Floette; if they drop Skarmory/Venusaur and need spread Ground consider Garchomp; keep Aegislash as Gardevoir answer. Venusaur-Mega confirmed Thick Fat via notebook; Brave Bird is the correct Flying STAB. Incineroar Taunt lock is key tempo advantage.

decisions.rationale: Overqwil checks the most likely answers: Intimidate and Knock Off resistance blunt Weavile, Taunt denies Venusaur Protect and Skarmory setup, and Poison Jab/Throat Chop reliably remove the weakened Venusaur. Aegislash walls Gardevoir/Sneasler but risks Weavile Knock Off and cannot Taunt or reliably finish Venusaur. Keeping Aegislash preserves the Gardevoir answer.
decisions.notebook: Overqwil is the flexible switch-in: Intimidate and Knock Off resistance check Weavile, Taunt stops Venusaur Protect and Skarmory Tailwind/Roost, and Poison Jab/Throat Chop reliably remove weakened Venusaur. Preserve Aegislash as the Gardevoir/Sneasler answer; its Flash Cannon does not guarantee Venusaur, and Weavile Knock Off can OHKO it. Rotom-Wash levitates Earth Power but must respect Giga Drain; Hydro Pump is inaccurate and resisted by Venusaur. Expect Weavile or Skarmory as physical pivots; Overqwil covers both better. If Venusaur is faster and chooses Earth Power, Overqwil can be OHKOed, so use Taunt/Protect or attack depending on speed read. Game 2: keep Aegislash for Gardevoir; consider Floette into Fighting/Sneasler leans, Garchomp if they drop Skarmory/Venusaur and bring spread Ground.

decisions.rationale: Venusaur at 19% is KO'd by Overqwil's Throat Chop (20.9-37.4%>19%) and Overqwil outspeeds it, so Venusaur must Protect to survive and stay as our Rotom answer. Gardevoir Moonblast is our best shot at removing the biggest threat (Overqwil, 2x), even though it's not a guaranteed OHKO (42.7-101.3%). Rotom's Hydro Pump only does 35.9-64.8% to Gardevoir, so Gardevoir is safe to attack. If Moonblast KOs Overqwil, Venusaur is safe next turn to Giga Drain Rotom (0.5x incoming) and heal.
decisions.notebook: Venusaur already Mega'd; Gardevoir cannot Mega this game (stays regular, Trace, no Pixilate). Overqwil Intimidate re-triggers on each switch-in. Weavile speed 194 outspeeds all foes (Rotom 106-138, Aegislash 72-100, Overqwil 105-137). Venusaur Giga Drain vs Rotom 61-136% possible OHKO; Venusaur safe vs Rotom (Hydro Pump/Thunderbolt both 0.5x). Gardevoir Moonblast 2x vs Overqwil but only 42.7-101.3% (not reliable OHKO); 0.5x vs Aegislash. Overqwil Throat Chop KOs a 19% Venusaur (20.9-37.4% of max); Overqwil Poison Jab 2x vs Gardevoir, 91-158.6% possible OHKO. Rotom Hydro Pump vs Gardevoir 35.9-64.8% (no OHKO). Gardevoir vs Overqwil speed uncertain (132 vs 105-137). Weavile Knock Off 2x vs Aegislash but contact (King's Shield risk); Icicle Crash 0.5x vs Aegislash. Avoid contact vs Aegislash King's Shield. Future: keep Weavile for speed/priority Ice Shard; Gardevoir handles Overqwil, Weavile handles Aegislash.

decisions.rationale: Poison Jab is a guaranteed KO on Venusaur at 18% across all legal spreads. Rotom Protects to avoid a potential Giga Drain OHKO (61-108%). If Venusaur Protects, we still keep Rotom healthy and can Taunt+attack next turn. Gardevoir's Pixilate Hyper Voice only does 36-63% to Overqwil, so Overqwil survives to act. Prioritizing the guaranteed Venusaur KO removes their -1 attacker and leaves us with a healthy core vs Gardevoir.
decisions.notebook: Overqwil Poison Jab guarantees KO on Venusaur-Mega at 18% (23-50.3% of max HP). Pixilate Hyper Voice is neutral on Overqwil (Poison resists Fairy), max 62.5%—Overqwil is a solid Mega Gardevoir check. Giga Drain from Venusaur can OHKO Rotom-Wash (61-108%), so Rotom must Protect or switch vs Venusaur. Earth Power maxes at 92% on Overqwil—survivable. Thunderbolt is NVE on Venusaur and unreliable for KO. Aegislash resists Hyper Voice (Steel resists Fairy) and Flash Cannon is SE vs Gardevoir—keep as Gardevoir answer. Weavile at 100% on bench is a major threat; Overqwil checks it via Intimidate + Knock Off resistance. Game 2: keep Aegislash for Gardevoir; consider Floette into Fighting/Sneasler leans, Garchomp if they drop Skarmory/Venusaur and bring spread Ground.

decisions.rationale: Venusaur at 19% is a liability and slow; switch it to Weavile (194 speed, outspeeds all foes). Gardevoir Moonblast reliably KOs Overqwil (min 42.7% > its 36% remaining) if it moves first; speed vs Overqwil is a coin flip, but Overqwil is low and likely to Protect, mitigating the Poison Jab OHKO risk. Removing Overqwil (Gardevoir's main threat) is high value while Weavile enters safely.
decisions.notebook: Venusaur already Mega'd; Gardevoir cannot Mega (stays regular, Trace, no Pixilate). Overqwil Intimidate re-triggers on each of ITS switch-ins. Weavile speed 194 outspeeds all foes (Rotom 106-138, Aegislash 72-100, Overqwil 105-137). Gardevoir Moonblast 2x vs Overqwil reliably KOs it when at/below ~42% (min roll 42.7%); Overqwil Poison Jab 2x can OHKO Gardevoir even at full HP (91-158.6%). Weavile Icicle Crash vs Overqwil only 20.3-65.6% (not reliable KO), Knock Off 0.5x vs Overqwil; Weavile is the Aegislash answer (Knock Off 2x) but avoid contact vs King's Shield. Gardevoir vs Overqwil speed uncertain (132 vs 105-137). Rotom Hydro Pump/Thunderbolt both 0.5x vs Venusaur; Venusaur Giga Drain can OHKO Rotom. Future: keep Weavile for speed/priority Ice Shard; Gardevoir handles Overqwil, Weavile handles Aegislash.

decisions.rationale: Protect Overqwil to scout Gardevoir's Hyper Voice and Venusaur's coverage while Rotom pivots into Aegislash. Aegislash walls Gardevoir, resists Giga Drain, survives Earth Power, and can later remove Venusaur or OHKO Weavile with Sacred Sword. This preserves Rotom as a healthy Weavile answer and avoids Overqwil being KOed before it can attack.
decisions.notebook: Aegislash is the primary Mega Gardevoir answer: it resists Pixilate Hyper Voice, is immune to Normal Hyper Voice as a Ghost, and survives even SE Earth Power from Venusaur, though it is slow and needs Protect/pivot support. Aegislash Sacred Sword OHKOes Weavile and Flash Cannon removes weakened Venusaur. Overqwil Poison Jab is excellent into Venusaur and Gardevoir, but Overqwil is fragile after chip: Pixilate Hyper Voice and SE Earth Power can remove it, so use Protect or pivots rather than attacking blindly. Rotom must respect Venusaur Giga Drain, which can OHKO it; Hydro Pump is the strongest Weavile answer but is inaccurate. Keep Rotom healthy to check Weavile. Game 2: keep Aegislash for Gardevoir; Overqwil checks Weavile with Intimidate; consider Floette into Fighting/Sneasler leans and Garchomp if they drop Skarmory/Venusaur and bring spread Ground.

decisions.rationale: Gardevoir Moonblast 2x reliably KOs Overqwil at 36% (min 42.7%), removing the Poison Jab that can OHKO Gardevoir. Weavile Knock Off 2x chips Aegislash 37-80% in Shield Forme; if Aegislash attacks it flips to Blade Forme and becomes KO-able next turn. Weavile outspeeds all foes, so it acts first. Acceptable King's Shield risk since a Shielded Aegislash doesn't attack this turn.
decisions.notebook: Gardevoir cannot Mega (Venusaur already Mega'd; stays regular Levitate/Trace). Overqwil Intimidate re-triggers on each of ITS switch-ins. Weavile 194 outspeeds all foes (Rotom 106-138, Aegislash 72-100, Overqwil 105-137). Gardevoir Moonblast 2x KOs Overqwil at/below ~42% (min 42.7%). Weavile Knock Off 2x on Aegislash Shield Forme = 37-80% (not KO); Icicle Crash only 12-25%. Aegislash in Shield Forme has high Def/low SpA; if it attacks it becomes Blade Forme (vulnerable). King's Shield blocks contact and drops attacker's Atk 2. Aegislash Flash Cannon 2x on Gardevoir only 18-71% (not OHKO); Overqwil Poison Jab 2x can OHKO Gardevoir (49-180%). Rotom Hydro Pump/Thunderbolt 0.5x vs Venusaur; Venusaur Giga Drain can OHKO Rotom. Keep Weavile for speed/priority Ice Shard; Gardevoir handles Overqwil, Weavile handles Aegislash.

decisions.rationale: Overqwil Poison Jab is the strongest Gardevoir answer (89-215%); even if Overqwil dies to Moonblast, it may KO first. Aegislash MUST King's Shield: Weavile Knock Off deals 82-148% to Shield forme, a real OHKO risk. Aegislash is too valuable vs Gardevoir/Venusaur to risk. Sacred Sword would OHKO Weavile but Aegislash moves last and could die to Knock Off first.
decisions.notebook: Weavile Knock Off can OHKO Aegislash even in Shield forme (82-148% with Life Orb); always King's Shield when Weavile is active and could target Aegislash. Aegislash Flash Cannon is NOT a reliable Gardevoir KO (46-101%); Overqwil Poison Jab (89-215%) is the primary Gardevoir kill. Sacred Sword OHKOes Weavile (97-235%) but Aegislash is slowest, so only use when protected or Weavile is weakened. Ice Shard is negligible vs Aegislash (9-15%). Gardevoir non-Mega Hyper Voice cannot KO Overqwil from 37%. Rotom-Wash resists Weavile Ice (0.5x) and is the best Weavile check via Hydro Pump. Venusaur-Mega at low HP can be cleaned by Flash Cannon or Poison Jab. Game 2: keep Aegislash for Gardevoir; Overqwil checks Weavile with Intimidate; consider Floette into Fighting/Sneasler leans and Garchomp if they drop Skarmory/Venusaur and bring spread Ground.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Weavile outspeeds all foes; Knock Off 2x chips Shield Aegislash 37-77%. If Aegislash attacks it flips to Blade Forme, where Knock Off jumps to ~50-104% (KO next turn). Gardevoir Moonblast pressures Rotom (38-87%) since Gardevoir is our only Rotom answer. Splitting hedges King's Shield: even if it blocks Weavile, Gardevoir still damages Rotom. Weavile may fall to Sacred Sword (70-147%), but then Aegislash is Blade Forme and Gardevoir can finish it.
decisions.notebook: Durable facts: Weavile Knock Off on Shield Aegislash (Atk -1) = 37-77%, not KO; on Blade Forme ~50-104% (possible KO). Gardevoir Moonblast on Rotom = 38-87%; on Shield Aegislash 15-32%, on Blade ~30-63%. Aegislash Sacred Sword 4x on Weavile = 70-147% (possible OHKO); Flash Cannon 2x on Weavile 38-79%. Rotom Hydro Pump on Gardevoir 36-65%, Thunderbolt 29-54%. Venusaur-Mega cannot damage Aegislash (Ghost immune Ground, Poison 0x Steel, Grass 0.5x); it only answers Rotom (Giga Drain OHKO). Opponent has NO benched Pokémon (Garchomp/Floette not brought); only Rotom+Aegislash remain. Aegislash King's Shield used twice, success rate reduced; Stance Change to Blade Forme triggers on using any damaging move even if blocked. Weavile Atk currently -1 (from King's Shield contact). Plan: keep Weavile as Aegislash answer, Gardevoir as Rotom answer; force Aegislash to Blade Forme then KO with Knock Off. If Weavile falls, Gardevoir Moonblast can KO Blade Aegislash. Future games: Overqwil Intimidate re-triggers each of its switch-ins; Gardevoir cannot Mega (Venusaur already Mega'd).

decisions.rationale: Weavile -1 Knock Off only does 40-69% to Shield Aegislash—survivable. Sacred Sword OHKOes Weavile back (97-235%). Hydro Pump chips 41-93%, possibly KOing first. Gardevoir's attacks (Moonblast 15-29%, even Pixilate HV 13-24%) can't finish Aegislash. Double-targeting Weavile eliminates the primary threat while Aegislash tanks in Shield forme.
decisions.notebook: Weavile Knock Off at -1 atk: 40-69% vs Aegislash Shield; burned+-1: 20-34%. Sacred Sword OHKOes Weavile 97-235%. Hydro Pump 41-93% vs Weavile (no guaranteed KO). Aegislash can tank -1 Knock Off in Shield and OHKO back. Gardevoir Moonblast only 15-29% vs Aegislash Shield at -1. Flash Cannon vs Gardevoir 46-101%, unreliable KO. Rotom-Wash best Weavile check via Hydro Pump. Venusaur-Mega at low HP cleaned by Flash Cannon or Hydro Pump. Game 2: keep Aegislash for Gardevoir; Overqwil checks Weavile with Intimidate; consider Floette into Fighting/Sneasler leans and Garchomp if they drop Skarmory/Venusaur and bring spread Ground.

decisions.rationale: Only Rotom-Wash remains (Aegislash fainted, no benched foes). Gardevoir Moonblast alone is 38-87% and Rotom sits at 40%, so it can survive a low roll. Weavile (fastest, 194) chips with Knock Off first, then Gardevoir Moonblast guarantees the KO. Even if Rotom outspeeds Gardevoir and KOs Weavile, Gardevoir still finishes Rotom for the win.
decisions.notebook: Durable facts: Weavile Knock Off on Shield Aegislash (Atk -1) 37-77%, not KO; on Blade ~50-104% possible KO. Gardevoir Moonblast on Rotom 38-87%; on Shield Aegislash 15-32%, Blade ~30-63%. Aegislash Sacred Sword 4x on Weavile 70-147% possible OHKO; Flash Cannon 2x 38-79%. Rotom Hydro Pump on Gardevoir 36-65%, Thunderbolt 29-54%. Venusaur-Mega cannot damage Aegislash (Ghost immune Ground, Poison 0x Steel, Grass 0.5x); only answers Rotom (Giga Drain OHKO). Weavile Knock Off on Rotom 16-36%. Opponent brought only Rotom+Aegislash+Overqwil+Talonflame; Garchomp/Floette not brought. Weavile Atk -1 from King's Shield contact. Future games: Overqwil Intimidate re-triggers each switch-in; Gardevoir cannot Mega (Venusaur already Mega'd this game).

decisions.rationale: Game is lost: Gardevoir Moonblast OHKOes Rotom-Wash from 40% (min roll 47.5%). No bench remains. Best play is Hydro Pump on Weavile at 17% to at least remove one threat before Rotom falls. Thunderbolt also KOs but Hydro Pump has higher damage ceiling if somehow relevant.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lost: Rotom-Wash alone cannot beat Gardevoir at 100% (Moonblast OHKOes from 40%). Key lesson: Aegislash is essential Gardevoir answer; Overqwil handles Weavile via Intimidate. Opponent team: Incineroar/Weavile/Venusaur-Mega/Gardevoir core; Sneasler and Skarmory not brought. Gardevoir has Levitate ability (unusual), Modest, Gardevoirite. Weavile Jolly Life Orb Pressure. Venusaur-Mega Modest. For Game 2: MUST keep Aegislash healthy for Gardevoir. Lead consideration: Overqwil Intimidate vs Weavile/Incineroar. Talonflame Tailwind support could help speed control. Rotom-Wash checks Weavile with Hydro Pump but cannot switch into Knock Off repeatedly. Priority: protect Aegislash from Weavile Knock Off crits; use King's Shield proactively. If opponent brings Sneasler, Aegislash and Talonflame are key. Consider Wide Lens Rotom for Hydro Pump accuracy. Gardevoir Moonblast crits are a real threat to Overqwil.

reflections.summary: Won because Turn 1 opponent wasted on Protect/King's Shield, letting Venusaur/Incineroar punish the Talonflame pivot. Gardevoir then Moonblasted Overqwil/Rotom while Weavile Knock Off finally broke Aegislash. Two crits shortened cleanup but the team-preview plan suited their slower core.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, consider leading Weavile/Gardevoir instead of Incineroar to avoid Rotom Hydro Pump KO and to pressure Aegislash/Overqwil faster. Keep Venusaur-Mega only if Talonflame or Floette-Eternal threaten; otherwise Mega Gardevoir for reliable Fairy damage.
reflections.notebook: Opponent opens defensively with Aegislash/Overqwil Protect/King's Shield and swaps Talonflame/Rotom aggressively. King's Shield drops contact Attack; Overqwil Intimidate re-triggers. Talonflame is Gale Wings SharpBeak Brave Bird/Flare Blitz. Rotom-Wash has Wide Lens and Hydro Pump/Thunderbolt/Will-O-Wisp. Occa Berry consumed on Aegislash. Garchomp/Floette-Eternal unseen. Future: Gardevoir Mega is viable when Venusaur not needed; Incineroar should avoid Rotom's Water attacks.

reflections.summary: Lost because the brought four had no Mega and only one reliable Gardevoir answer; Aegislash was forced into the Weavile matchup and removed by Knock Off before Gardevoir was answered.
reflections.adjustment: Game 2: reserve Aegislash for Gardevoir, use Rotom-Wash/Intimidate/Protect to handle Weavile, and predict Knock Off with King's Shield or Protect before committing Aegislash.
reflections.notebook: Opponent's revealed plan: Mega-evolve Venusaur, use Fake Out/Intimidate tempo, pressure with Weavile Knock Off to remove Steel checks, and preserve Gardevoir as a Modest Moonblast cleaner; Gardevoir has unusual Levitate. Durable matchup facts: Aegislash is the key Gardevoir check but is vulnerable to Weavile Knock Off; Rotom-Wash pressures Incineroar/Weavile but cannot repeatedly take Knock Off or beat Gardevoir; Overqwil is Intimidate utility and must avoid Moonblast; Talonflame can threaten Venusaur but cannot safely switch into Sludge Bomb. Future plan: keep Aegislash healthy, bait Knock Off with Protect/King's Shield, and force Gardevoir to deal with Aegislash rather than letting Weavile remove it.
